wp_ktp_client:
CREATE TABLE `wp_ktp_client` (
  `id` mediumint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,

  `url` varchar(55) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci DEFAULT NULL,

  `email` varchar(100) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci DEFAULT '',
  `phone` varchar(20) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `postal_code` varchar(10) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `prefecture` tinytext CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci,
  `city` tinytext CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci,
  `address` text CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci,
  `building` tinytext CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci,
  `closing_day` tinytext CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci,
  `payment_month` tinytext CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci,
  `payment_day` tinytext CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci,
  `payment_method` tinytext CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci,
  `tax_category` varchar(100) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT '内税',
  `payment_timing` varchar(20) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'postpay',
  `memo` text CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci,
  `search_field` text CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci,
  `frequency` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `client_status` varchar(100) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT '対象',
  `inquiry_blocked` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '公開商品問い合わせブロック（1=ブロック中）',
  `category` varchar(255) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT '0000-00-00 00:00:00',
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT '0000-00-00 00:00:00',
  `selected_department_id` int DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '選択された部署ID',
  `stripe_customer_id` varchar(255) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Stripe Customer ID',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),

  KEY `selected_department_id` (`selected_department_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci
wp_ktp_contract:
CREATE TABLE `wp_ktp_contract` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `client_id` mediumint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `service_id` mediumint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `contract_name` varchar(255) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `amount` decimal(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0.00',
  `billing_cycle` varchar(20) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'monthly',
  `billing_day` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '1' COMMENT '1-28, 99=月末',
  `payment_due_mode` varchar(20) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'contract' COMMENT 'contract=契約請求日, client=顧客締め支払日',
  `start_date` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `end_date` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `status` varchar(20) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' COMMENT 'active, paused, cancelled',
  `stripe_subscription_id` varchar(255) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Stripe Subscription ID',
  `next_billing_date` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `first_billed` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '初回請求済み',
  `send_reminder_mail` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '1' COMMENT '請求予定メール送信',
  `memo` text CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `client_id` (`client_id`),
  KEY `service_id` (`service_id`),
  KEY `status` (`status`),
  KEY `next_billing_date` (`next_billing_date`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci
wp_ktp_contract_billing_log:

wp_ktp_department:
CREATE TABLE `wp_ktp_department` (

wp_ktp_invoice_items:
CREATE TABLE `wp_ktp_invoice_items` (

wp_ktp_order:
CREATE TABLE `wp_ktp_order` (
  `id` mediumint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `client_id` mediumint DEFAULT NULL,
  `contract_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '定期契約ID',
  `billing_period` char(7) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT '' COMMENT '請求対象月YYYY-MM',
  `client_department_id` int DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '依頼元部署ID',
  `project_name` varchar(255) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `order_date` date NOT NULL COMMENT '受注日',
  `desired_delivery_date` date DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '希望納期',
  `expected_delivery_date` date DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '納品予定日',
  `total_amount` decimal(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0.00' COMMENT '合計金額',
  `status` varchar(20) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' COMMENT 'ステータス',
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT '0000-00-00 00:00:00',
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT '0000-00-00 00:00:00',
  `time` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `customer_name` varchar(100) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci NOT NULL,
  `user_name` tinytext CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci,
  `progress` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `memo` text CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci,
  `search_field` text CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci,
  `payment_timing` varchar(20) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '支払タイミング（NULL=顧客に従う, postpay, prepay）',
  `external_source` varchar(50) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '連携元（例: woocommerce）',
  `external_order_id` varchar(100) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '外部注文ID',
  `completion_date` date DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '完了日',
  `order_number` varchar(50) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '受注番号',
  `delivery_date_1` date DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '納期1',
  `delivery_date_2` date DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '納期2',
  `delivery_date_3` date DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '納期3',
  `delivery_status_1` varchar(50) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci DEFAULT 'pending' COMMENT '納期1のステータス',
  `delivery_status_2` varchar(50) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci DEFAULT 'pending' COMMENT '納期2のステータス',
  `delivery_status_3` varchar(50) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci DEFAULT 'pending' COMMENT '納期3のステータス',
  `client_company` varchar(255) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'クライアント会社名',
  `order_status` varchar(50) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci DEFAULT 'draft' COMMENT '受注ステータス',
  `invoice_items` text CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci,
  `cost_items` text CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci,
  `closing_day` varchar(50) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '締め日',
  `payment_month` varchar(50) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '支払月',
  `payment_day` varchar(50) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '支払日',
  `payment_method` varchar(100) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '支払方法',
  `tax_category` varchar(100) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci DEFAULT '税込' COMMENT '税区分',
  `company_name` varchar(255) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `stripe_invoice_id` varchar(255) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Stripe Invoice ID',
  `stripe_invoice_url` varchar(512) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Stripe hosted invoice URL',
  `stripe_paid_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Stripe入金日時',
  `stripe_subscription_id` varchar(255) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Stripe Subscription ID',
  `promised_delivery_date` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `progress_locked` tinyint(1) DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '1=入金済で取り込み、進捗を固定',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `order_number` (`order_number`),
  KEY `client_id` (`client_id`),
  KEY `order_date` (`order_date`),
  KEY `idx_expected_delivery_date` (`expected_delivery_date`),
  KEY `idx_completion_date` (`completion_date`),
  KEY `idx_order_number` (`order_number`),
  KEY `idx_client_company` (`client_company`),
  KEY `idx_order_status` (`order_status`),
  KEY `idx_delivery_date_1` (`delivery_date_1`),
  KEY `client_department_id` (`client_department_id`),
  KEY `ktp_progress_time` (`progress`,`time`),
  KEY `ktp_client_progress_completion` (`client_id`,`progress`,`completion_date`),
  KEY `ktp_progress_promised` (`progress`,`promised_delivery_date`),
  KEY `ktp_client_time` (`client_id`,`time`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci
wp_ktp_order_cost_items:

wp_ktp_order_customer_mail_log:
